title: Fix CSV rerun pending destination collisions
summary: CSV rerun pending-publish destination resolution now suffixes already queued server_out targets for non-fail policies instead of failing auto pending-review rows.
reason: Live CSV reruns using auto_replace_clean_else_pending_review failed when a prior pending-publish manifest already reserved the same final destination.
behavior_before: When auto_replace_clean_else_pending_review routed an issue-bearing output to Pending Publish review, the forced replace_final collision policy made an already queued pending destination fail the row.
behavior_after: Pending-publish destination collisions still fail for collision_policy=fail, but replace_final and suffix policies resolve the new pending manifest to a non-overlapping server_out so the pending manifest set stays unique.
tests_added: ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-RerunAutoDestinationChecks.ps1 covers auto pending-review reruns when an existing pending manifest reserves the requested server_out.
rollback_plan: Revert the touched rerun entrypoint, focused PowerShell test, generated summaries, and this change packet. Existing live pending manifests are not modified by this change.
notes:
Allow non-fail CSV rerun pending-publish collisions to resolve to unique server_out destinations.
Refresh generated summary after rerun destination policy change.
Refresh generated summary after focused rerun test update.
Cover auto pending-review rerun with a pre-existing pending manifest that already reserves the requested server_out.
